# Markdown Source

Markdown fixture for loader coverage.

## Methods

The sponsor should retain the submission checklist before final audit review.

| Step | Owner | Record |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Intake | QA | Submission checklist |
| Audit review | QA lead | Final memo |

## Results

The retained checklist stayed linked to the final audit review packet.

### 4.2.1 Batch Release Records

Batch release records should preserve the review trail, the checklist reference,
and the final disposition note as separate traceable entries.

## Limitations

The sponsor should retain the submission checklist before final audit review; however,
the retained checklist showed no significant effect in patients over 65.
